title: Flexibility Test Tracker
description: Log sit-and-reach results against age and gender reference ranges.
howto: Select gender and enter your age.
Enter your sit-and-reach result in centimeters (fingertips past toes).
Click Log result to compare against the reference range.
Track progress in the history log saved in your browser.

faqs.a: Sit with legs straight, feet against a box, and reach forward as far as possible. The score is how far past your toes your fingertips go, in cm.
Approximate typical ranges by decade for illustration. Below the range suggests below-average trunk/leg flexibility.
Consistent hamstring and hip stretching over weeks. This tool tracks the numbers; it does not prescribe training.
